name: AABB Collision Detection
aliases: AABB Collision Detection — Axis-Aligned Bounding Box Collision
Axis-Aligned Bounding Box collision with axis-separated movement
definition: A collision detection method for a camera represented as an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) against a voxel world. It moves the camera one axis at a time, checking for collisions, and cancels movement if a collision occurs.
